notes.title: Global Update 1.2
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

In this update we took into account all the wishes of the players and changed the game accordingly, and at the same time fixing some bugs:

1. There is a button to start a new game in the pause menu. Now you do not have to first kill your character to start a new game.
2. Prescribed all the random events (in two languages: Russian and English) after the post Manager, which may happen to you at work.
You will no longer see the standard notification "Positive Event 1".
3. changed the icons of other items in the store to a more beautiful and better quality.
4) Fixed some bugs, when buys are doubled in the store. There should be no strange charges.
5. The game decided to crash only one user, but we still slightly optimized it as a whole. 
6. Many players complained that the time in the game went too slow, making the gameplay boring.
That's why it was decided to speed up the game time. The pause button didn't go anywhere, so you can always pause the game and build further strategy.
7. Added a tooltip when hovering over the save game button, which says that the game is periodically saved automatically. This is for your peace of mind.
8. Updated the start date of the new game, keep up to date ;)
9. Redesigned game balance.
10. Added a tooltip when hovering over the hourglass. There you can also see if the pause now or not.
11. Removed button to open the business. This functionality has gone on a complete redesign, and will appear in the next update.
12. In the description of the car and real estate in the purchase is now brought out the tax that you have to pay every day for the maintenance of the car, or house after its purchase.

At this point all known issues have been fixed, thank you for your feedback! We will continue to improve the project and fill it with content to keep your time interesting.

notes.title: Announcing COSMO
notes.content:
Hi!
We would like to share with you the good news, we are announcing a new space project - COSMO, which we first started doing about seven years ago, and only now it has reached Steam. ːsteamhappyː This is a cooperative sandbox, where the player has to become a spacecraft pilot and choose his way in the open, ever-growing world of the game. There waiting for you PvE battles with friends, research, resource extraction, industry and construction.

To learn more about the game, click on the picture below.

https://sun9-62.userapi.com/pGsNLEctNTGemVM2GAQRkVYHrjd4OBLbQ3LUGA/H5N6S7lq5Fo.jpg


Here you are free to decide what you want to do. Explore space, make new discoveries, extract resources, build new ships, equip them with modules, engage in industry, pump character skills, and much more. You can do all this at once alone, or you can invite a friend to the game and share the responsibilities. Together is always more fun and faster things go.

Key features of the game:

 Borderless space
 Cooperative mode
 Total freedom of action
 A lot of different activities
 More than 15 enemy ships with unique features, tactics and different characteristics
 Over 20 types of resources needed for construction or trade
 About 30 different ships (from a mining or cargo ship to a real war monster).
 Over 50 character skills, opening up new opportunities
 Over 100 modules of different types to equip the spacecraft


Add Cosmo to your wish list so you don't miss its release and know all the latest news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461900/

You can also subscribe to our YouTube channel to learn more about the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LedqIf-qWa0
See you in space, pilot!
